thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 inference latency spike in us-east-1 for model: redwood-mix-3 (p99 > 4.2s, sustained 10m). paging on-call.

oncall-anya: acked. joining bridge — can someone add customer-impact numbers?
mike: joining. looks like new autoscale warmup after a deploy is causing batch backpressure to pile up. seeing big KV cache misses.
lisa: I’m on infra side, checking dedicated pools and routing. temporarily diverting traffic to warm pools in us-west-2.
zach: adding a manual route rule now: route model redwood-mix-3 -> redwood-mix-3-v1 (older compiled variant) for 20% of traffic.
ops-bot: BRIDGE: https://meet.company/bridge/2401005432 (incident-2401005432) | Pager: oncall-anya | Severity: sev2
oncall-anya: mike/lisa — any quick rollback plan? we should prioritize customer-visible reduction over perfect root cause.
mike: plan: rollback model rollouts for the _recent_ v2 binary -> v1 across all zones. rolling in us-east-1 first.
lisa: reroute + rollback started. applying suppression to streaming timeouts temporarily to avoid cascaded alerts.
ops-bot: ACTION: rollback started by mike at 2401005620. Re-route applied by lisa at 2401005665.
product-ellen: product report — preliminary: 6 customers saw increased end-to-end latency; one integration returned 504s intermittently. ramp peaked ~12m.
zach: KV cache miss rate peaked at 18% (baseline ~2%). suspect the new kernel selection path invalidated some cache indexes.
oncall-anya: good mitigation. hold oncall bridge for 10m and re-evaluate. please post customer-impact and followups here.
mike: rollback complete in us-east-1 at 2401005910. p99 dropped to 1.2s within 60s. will continue rollbacks to other regions.
lisa: reroute removed after rollback stabilization. autoscaler warmup tune adjusted: longer pre-warm window + staggered start.
ops-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated — services stable at 2401006023. paging cleared.
oncall-anya: thanks team. please file a postmortem and schedule review. propose tomorrow 10:00am PT for postmortem sync.
product-ellen: booked postmortem: calendar invite sent to eng-runtime, eng-ml, oncall rotation, and product.
mike: initial action items (short):
- A1: revert model rollout gating to require KV-cache compatibility checks (owner: mike)
- A2: add synthetic warmup checks before traffic shift (owner: lisa)
- A3: create an alert that correlates p99 spikes with KV cache miss rate before paging (owner: zach)
- A4: notify customers who had 504s and add SLA note (owner: product-ellen)
oncall-anya: followups for monitoring/alerting:
- Reduce noisy paging: only page when p99 > 3s AND customer-impact > 5% OR error-rate > 2% for 5m
- Add a 2m suppression window for autoscale-induced warmup spikes (so we don't page on expected transient)
- Add per-model heatmap to console to spot rollout-induced tails

lisa: will PR the suppression window change to ops-alerts repo today.
zach: I’ll add the correlation alert rule and a Grafana dashboard panel for KV miss vs p99. draft of alert rule:
```
alert: Inference_P99_With_KV
expr: (sum(rate(inference_p99[5m])) by (region,model) > 3) and (sum(rate(kv_miss_ratio[5m])) by (region,model) > 0.05)
for: 5m
labels: { severity: "page" }
annotations: { summary: "p99 latency with high KV miss - possible rollout/warmup" }
```

product-ellen: timeline note: incident window ~2401005400-2401006023. customer comms draft in #support after postmortem.
mike: tagging owners in ticket tracker: INC-2401005432. adding remediation ETA: 3d for gating and warmup checks.
oncall-anya: nice. next steps: postmortem doc (owner: mike), alert tune PRs (owners: lisa/zach), customer comms (product-ellen). schedule pinned for review at 10:00am PT tomorrow.
ops-bot: REMINDERS: assign tickets and update INC-2401005432 before postmortem.
product-ellen: thanks all — good catch/quick rollback. will follow up with customer list after review. :thumbsup:
